user.title: Calisthenics tracker profile
user.description: Set up your local profile and training targets.

error.future_start_date: Start date cannot be in the future.

abort.already_configured: Only one tracker profile is supported.

not_loaded.message: The tracker integration is not loaded.

invalid_storage.message: Local tracker storage is invalid or inaccessible.

invalid_session_type.message: Session type must be A or B.

future_timestamp.message: Timestamp cannot be in the future.

end_before_start.message: Completion time must be after the start.

invalid_notes.message: Notes must be a text value.

storage_failed.message: Could not write local tracker data.

unknown_exercise.message: The exercise ID is not in the local exercise catalog.

workout_plan_unavailable.message: The workout suggestion is unavailable because its exercises are missing.

invalid_exercise.message: Select an exercise from the catalog.

invalid_sets.message: Sets must be a non-empty list of positive numbers.

invalid_rir.message: RIR must be an integer from 0 to 5.

invalid_pain_score.message: Pain score must be an integer from 0 to 10.

empty_measurement.message: Enter at least one measurement value.

invalid_weight.message: Weight must be greater than 0 and no more than 500 kg.

invalid_waist.message: Waist circumference must be greater than 0 and no more than 300 cm.

invalid_resting_heart_rate.message: Resting heart rate must be an integer from 1 to 300 bpm.

invalid_steps.message: Steps must be a non-negative integer.

invalid_sleep_hours.message: Sleep must be between 0 and 24 hours.

invalid_calorie_intake.message: Calorie intake must be a finite non-negative number.

invalid_protein_grams.message: Protein must be a finite non-negative number.

start_workout.name: Start workout
start_workout.description: Start and persist an A or B workout.

suggest_workout.name: Suggest workout
suggest_workout.description: Return a goal-focused exercise routine for the level in your profile.

focus.name: Focus
focus.description: Choose the main goal for the suggested routine.

complete_workout.name: Complete workout
complete_workout.description: Complete the active workout and persist duration.

cancel_workout.name: Cancel workout
cancel_workout.description: Cancel and preserve the active workout. It is not counted as complete.

log_exercise.name: Log exercise
log_exercise.description: Log separate set values. A later log for the same exercise replaces its previous log in the active workout.

exercise_id.name: Exercise
exercise_id.description: Stable ID from the local exercise catalog.

sets.name: Sets
sets.description: Non-empty list containing one positive number per set.

pain_score.name: Pain score
pain_score.description: Integer from 0 to 10. Scores of 4 or higher produce a caution.

add_body_measurement.name: Add body measurement
add_body_measurement.description: Store body and wellbeing measurements locally.

resting_heart_rate.name: Resting heart rate
resting_heart_rate.description: Optional resting heart rate in beats per minute.
